businessTools.title: Zana za Biashara

businessTools.supportedFormats: Muundo unaotumika: Word (.doc, .docx), Excel (.xls, .xlsx), PowerPoint (.ppt, .pptx), PDF (.pdf)

businessTools.noToolsUserMessage: Violezo vya biashara na zana zitaonekana hapa zikishapakiwa na wasimamizi.
